Published curated text/area search; simple lexeme AND matching, case-folded exact area, ID-descending keyset. Cursor bound to normalized query/area; live pages.
Preview explicit planned-trip title/reorder/keep-all append. Pins source bytes, expires after 15 minutes; no graph mutation. Apply rechecks revision/source and journal protection.

Atomically apply approved preview at expected revision. Stable immutable owner/request receipt survives later edits. Appends keep both source occurrences; old adjacency estimates are invalidated. Journal/pending-upload topology is protected.

Private session. Recent device-reported sample within distance+accuracy <=100m; max age30s/future10s, max20 sessions/hour. Expires after15m. Repeat original request exactly for idempotency. Raw coordinates are not persisted. This does not certify physical presence or image authenticity.

After create-only raw Storage upload, enqueue byte validation. Poll same operation for status; finalization is worker-only. Accepted pending session is not re-evaluated for location when processing is delayed.
Owner-only accepted private journal projection. Download via authenticated private Storage URL; no public URLs. Journal acceptance does not complete trip/stop.
Create-only; exact path from upload session. No client upsert/update/delete/read of raw objects. PNG/JPEG <=5MiB; worker validates actual bytes before private publication.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation bound to the authenticated account. Pass unchanged; null means the final page.

time_zone.description: Explicit PostgreSQL-recognized IANA zone (UTC or region/name); null for legacy creation. Not inferred from a timestamp offset.

local_start_date.description: Server-derived destination calendar date; null when legacy zone is unknown.

stop_order.description: Explicit ordered retained occurrence IDs. Nonempty, unique subset of current IDs; omitted occurrences are removed only if the plan has no pending/accepted journals. Lets the user resolve overlap after a keep-all append.

append_source.description: Pinned source bytes for review; authoritative identity and copied stops are immutable until apply.
